description: This file contains the implementation of a custom memory allocator for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including buffer pool management, memory allocation/deallocation, and event recording functionalities.

classes.name: MPSAllocator
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) memory allocations, conforming to the IMPSAllocator interface, providing methods for allocation, deallocation, and buffer management.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a Metal buffer of a specified size and usage, returning a DataPtr wrapping the buffer.

methods.name: allocScalarBufferWithValue
methods.description: Creates a scalar buffer initialized with a specific value.

methods.name: getSharedBufferPtr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a shared buffer and its retain count.

methods.name: isSharedBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a given buffer pointer is a shared buffer.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Clears internal caches of the allocator.
